@June Osei-Lark, Gideon closed **ticket #8841** with support on 1 Jul. He said the fix was that Vantorre's IT cleared a browser cache issue on the kiosk tablets, after which the standard Detention Summary template worked for their billing team, so no custom CSV export was needed.

A 30 Sep digest in the shared notes describes #8841 differently, as a Newark Door 14 check-in kiosk escalation to platform engineering. That may be a reused ticket number or a mix-up, so check the ticket itself before relying on either description.
